decision: Owner-selected beam-and-block system. The displayed 150 mm beams and 100 mm topping are provisional geometry, not accepted member sizes: vehicle/jacking load design, reinforcement, bearings and temporary works require supplier/engineer design. Solid RC is retained as a comparison; installed savings are not established.
profileBasis: 150 x 165 mm overall envelope and 50.06 kg/m from Stressline guide. Simplified 115 mm web / 50 mm flange are VISUAL allowances, not manufacturer dimensions. Straight beams depict nominal datum; no tendons, camber curve or fabrication geometry is claimed.

supplierReference.title: Stressline Flooring Systems Guide, 2017, pages 10 and 12
supplierReference.limitation: Legacy BS 8110 table. Values are reference benchmarks ONLY, not verified current Eurocode resistances. The 100 mm topping, finishes, partitions, actual vehicle axle/wheel/jack loads, fire exposure and basement restraint need a fresh supplier design. No equal sharing between beams is established.

openDesign: Current manufacturer design for beams, floor-grade infill, topping reinforcement and camber; no composite beam credit assumed.
Actual van gross/axle weights, paired wheel positions, jack contact patch, load distribution and local topping bending/punching; UDL and isolated point cases below are separate sensitivities.
RC edge strips, central closure and existing opening bands: reinforcement, anchorage, bearing stress, restraint and complete reactions through the masonry to the raft.
Basement lateral restraint/diaphragm and wall ties; water protection at edges, joints and garage threshold; groundwater uplift including construction stages.
Fire resistance from either side, protected basement ceiling, thermal insulation and acoustic layers. A legacy half-hour beam rating is not a complete garage/basement separation design.
Temporary erection stability, lifting access, wet topping and construction loads, cure period and propping. No cutting/drilling of prestressed beams.
Topping reinforcement, RC edge formwork, delivery/lifting, membrane/insulation, ceiling and professional design remain unpriced; quantities are not an order schedule.
